Privacy, plainly.

Updated 27 October 2026

Document explorer

The explorer processes text inside your browser tab. It does not send document contents to an AI service or store them in a database. Text is cleared on reload. Use sample or non-sensitive text.

Project enquiries

The form creates an email draft in this tab. No message is submitted by this website. If you choose to send an email, your email provider processes it and Aishwarya receives the information you include. Avoid passwords, API keys and confidential documents.

Other services

This site uses Google Fonts, which receives ordinary network request information when fonts load. External links to GitHub and LinkedIn have their own policies. Hosting and access services may process connection or access logs under their own terms. No custom analytics, advertising trackers or marketing cookies are installed in the portfolio code.
